name: flex-rigid
description: Flex and rigid-flex boards. The pipeline generates and checks the electrical design, but bend radius, stiffener, coverlay, assembly and mechanical reliability require human sign-off.
notes: Do not autoroute across a bend area; keep conductors perpendicular to the bend and use curved traces.
Confirm coverlay, stiffener, adhesive and bend-radius requirements with the fabricator.
The pipeline cannot certify flex fatigue life.
